Gates are locked outside set hours; dogs and ball games are not permitted

name: CERES Community Environment Park

facts.claim: Public community environment park in Brunswick East with farm, nursery, organic grocery and cafe
Free to visit; has a market every Saturday
Includes Terra Wonder Playspace, market gardens and a bike shed

name: Jewish Museum of Australia

facts.claim: Jewish heritage and culture museum at 26 Alma Road, St Kilda
General adult admission $18; children under 10 free
Free Fridays program runs to 18 Dec 2026
